cases.note: §7.6 crossing §17. The robot resolves its own ceilings and guard partition and until this field existed nothing carried them: §32.1 asks a device page for exactly this and the Hub’s own route answered with a `gaps` list naming it. Frozen because the two halves of the sentence an operator reads — which guards run, and whether anything enforces them — are in different fields, and an edition that agreed about one could disagree about the other.
